paper.abstract_en: Quantum M2-brane instantons are studied in eleven-dimensional Freund-Rubin backgrounds. The construction uses the identification of the Calabi-Yau cone over the Sasaki-Einstein manifold $\mathrm{SE}_7$ with the geometric branch of the abelian moduli space of the dual superconformal field theory. A class of BPS cycles in $\mathrm{SE}_7$ wrapped by M2-branes is identified as links of two-dimensional holomorphic cones whose coordinate rings contain BPS monopole operators. The algebraic structure and R-charge assignment on the moduli space further allow the computation of both the classical exponents and one-loop partition functions of the corresponding M2-brane instantons. Several three-dimensional superconformal field theories are analysed explicitly, and the relation to the corresponding localisation matrix models is discussed.
